newsitem.title: UK: Iran features again in sugar freight enquiry.
newsitem.headline: Iran features again in sugar freight enquiry.

text.p: Iran again featured as a quoted end-destination on London's sugar freight market with the second inquiry seen so far this week, shipbrokers said on Wednesday.
E D & F Man renewed its freight interest in Iran, quoting for 30,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Paranagua to Iran for early August.
On Tuesday Man entered the market with another Iran order for 14,000 tonnes in bags from South Africa.
Little physical demand has been seen in recent weeks from Iran, which has bought increased steady amounts of both white and raw sugar throughout the year.
Man also quoted for a further 24,000 tonnes from Paranagua to Casablanca for August 10/15.
Lorico was open for 10,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from Rio de Janeiro to the Egyptian Mediterranean for August 20/25.
Of the day's firmer business, Belize Sugar Industries was reported to have fixed its recent order for 7,000 tonnes in bulk from Belize to Nantes for mid-August.
SASA fixed 18,000 tonnes from Durban to Japan for August 16/20, while shipbrokers said CSR had covered 20,000 tonnes in bulk from Queensland to Ho Chi Minh City for prompt dates.
